subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should #43367 remain the canonical umbrella while focused fixes land, or should maintainers replace it with narrower canonical issues for session-lock ownership, durable completion delivery, fallback lanes, and cancellation semantics?
rationale: The bug is valid, but the durable fix spans core session ownership, message-delivery guarantees, provider failover behavior, and detached child cleanup, so automation should not choose the architecture boundary alone.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open, require focused PRs or issues for each root cause, and close the umbrella only when the linked symptoms are fixed or explicitly split.

options.title: Promote Completion Isolation Design
options.body: Make #96975 the canonical product direction for the completion-isolation slice and link the remaining lock, fallback, and cancellation bugs to separate owners.

options.title: Split By Failure Mode
options.body: Select one canonical tracker each for config writes, session locks, subagent delivery, auth failover, and detached work, then close this umbrella after preserving production evidence links.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, require focused PRs or issues for each root cause, and close the umbrella only when the linked symptoms are fixed or explicitly split.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily an agent/session architecture and product-boundary decision, and steipete is the strongest available routing signal from VISION-level guidance and subagent/session history.
